name: Scorch Veil
description: Hang a veil of heat haze before the foe so every step and aim goes astray.

name: Cinder Rain
description: Let a fine rain of glowing cinders fall over a wide patch of ground.

name: Gilded Purge
description: Burn a deep curse or binding out of an ally in a long gold light.

name: Sunburn Wave
description: Send a rolling wave of burning light along the ground at the foe.

name: Blazing Lance
description: Hurl a lance of white fire that pierces plate and bone in a long burning line.

name: Zenith Mantle
description: Wrap the user and the near ranks in a mantle of bright fire that turns heavy assault.

name: Solar Revival
description: Pour the full strength of the sun into a freshly fallen ally to restart the heart.

name: Glaring Judgement
description: Cast a glare so heavy that all hostile qi in sight sinks under it.

name: Starburn Lance
description: Spear the foe with a shaft of fire hot enough to bore through a shield of stone.

name: Corona Rending
description: Tear the foe with the edge of the sun's rim in one blow.

name: Sunlit Absorption
description: Drink the full force of a great strike into the body and turn it into light.

name: Fallen Daystar
description: The school's finishing move in which a small sun is called down and let fall on the ground with a force that grows with the user's reserve.

name: Sunfall Cataclysm
description: Bring the sun itself down on the field so that the ground melts and the air burns away at the full destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Noon Scourge
description: Whip the noon glare in great sweeps across the ground to scorch all that stands.

name: Sunwash Purge
description: Wash a flood of clean white light through an ally and lift every taint from the body.

name: Lumen Rouse
description: Flood an ally with bright strength that holds through the whole fight.

name: Gilded Brand
description: Brand a foe with a mark of gold fire that drags at every step.

name: Firmament Lance
description: Throw a lance of light from the top of the sky that stabs down through the foe and the ground beneath.

name: Sunward Mantle
description: Raise a vast mantle of sun that covers all allies in sight and breaks heavy blows.

name: Highnoon Restoration
description: Bathe the wounded in the glare of high noon until deep wounds knit before the eye.

name: Scalding Dominion
description: Press a scalding light on every foe in sight and pin their qi beneath its weight.

name: Furnace Crown
description: Set a crown of furnace fire on the user and loose it outward as a ring of ruin.

name: Dayheart Absorb
description: Take the strength of a great attack into the heart of the day and make it light.

name: Noonblaze Flash
description: Vanish in a burst of noon fire and reappear anywhere the light reaches.

name: Sunlord Edict
description: The school's decree spoken beneath a blazing sky that bars lesser aggressive qi from rising in the user's presence.

name: Day Dominion
description: The school's greatest gift in which the user's sun rules the field and lifts and guards every ally who stands within it.

name: Worldburn Noon
description: Lift the noon sun to terror so the sky whitens and the land below burns at the full destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Solar Annihilation
description: Fire the whole sun as a single shaft that bores through all in its line to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.
